backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no state or functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping premium interactive storytelling features to their related files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend pages and components used in the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme configuration defining CSS variables for light/dark modes and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with four routes wrapped in SiteLayout.
frontend/src/components/background/FilmG: Full‑screen film‑grain texture overlay for aesthetic background noise.
frontend/src/components/cursor/HeartRipp: Click‑triggered animated heart ripple effect respecting reduced‑motion settings.
frontend/src/components/cursor/Valentine: Custom animated cursor with glowing dot and trailing ring that reacts to hover.
frontend/src/components/GlassCard.tsx: Reusable glassmorphic card wrapper with blur, gradient, and border styling.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Global layout providing navbar, custom cursor, ripple layer, background visuals, and providers.
frontend/src/components/motion/ParallaxL: Parallax wrapper applying scroll‑based vertical translation unless reduced motion is enabled.
frontend/src/components/motion/Reveal.ts: Intersection‑observer reveal animation that fades and translates content into view.
frontend/src/components/motion/SectionTi: Simple wrapper component intended for coordinating section‑level animations.
frontend/src/components/music/Background: Provides context and controls for background music playback, including fade-in/out and volume management.
frontend/src/components/music/MiniPlayer: A small UI player that toggles background music and adjusts volume using the music context.
frontend/src/components/nav/PremiumNavba: A responsive navigation bar with scroll-based styling, active link highlighting, and a mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/scroll/SmoothScr: Context provider exposing a smooth scroll function using a custom hook.
frontend/src/components/SectionHeader.ts: Shared section header component with gradient title, optional subtitle, and accent line.
frontend/src/components/sections/Favorit: Displays a styled card with a placeholder area for embedding a favorite song.
frontend/src/components/sections/Flipboo: Renders an animated flipbook-style love story with page navigation and motion-aware transitions.
frontend/src/components/sections/LoveLet: Shows a love letter with a typewriter effect triggered on scroll, respecting reduced-motion settings.
frontend/src/components/sections/LovePuz: Interactive puzzle rearranging pieces to reveal a message, with completion detection and reset controls.
frontend/src/components/sections/Monthly: Carousel-style section letting users switch between monthly memory entries with animations and a detailed card view.
frontend/src/components/sections/Polaroi: Displays a grid of rotating polaroid-style images that enlarge and straighten on hover using simple animations.
Renders a clickable polaroid wall where selecting an item opens a modal-style enlarged view with motion effects.
frontend/src/components/sections/Questio: Interactive Q&A game that cycles through prompts, records selected answers, and reveals responses before moving on.
frontend/src/components/sections/TravelM: Travel memory carousel with destination info, expandable narrative text, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/components/sections/Valenti: Countdown component showing time remaining until Valentine's Day 2026, switching to a celebration message once past.
Hero section with parallax effects, animated heart visuals, and a CTA that smooth-scrolls to the next section.
frontend/src/components/sections/VoiceNo: Displays a list of audio voice notes with play/pause controls, progress tracking, and animated UI states.
frontend/src/content/premiumInteractiveS: Defines TypeScript interfaces and content arrays for interactive sections like puzzles, Q&A, travel memories, and voice notes.
frontend/src/content/story.ts: Provides static story text for various page sections, including hero, about us, and how we met.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: Implements a countdown timer hook that updates remaining time until a target date.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Handles Internet Identity auth lifecycle, exposing identity, login, logout, and status via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsTouchDevice.ts: Detects whether the device supports touch input and updates on resize.
frontend/src/hooks/useMagneticHover.ts: Adds a magnetic hover animation effect to an element unless reduced motion is preferred.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Detects the user's reduced-motion preference using a media query.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file noting no backend queries are used.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollProgress.ts: Tracks the window's vertical scroll position using requestAnimationFrame for performance.
frontend/src/hooks/useSmoothScroll.ts: Provides a smooth scrolling hook that animates wheel and programmatic scroll interactions with reduced‑motion support.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, custom OKLCH color variables, themes, utility classes, accessibility settings, and cursor/animation behavior.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a helper that merges Tailwind and conditional class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with react-query and Internet Identity context, then mounts App.
frontend/src/pages/FinalePage.tsx: Renders the final Valentine page with a love letter, countdown, decorative card, and footer.
frontend/src/pages/GalleryMusicPage.tsx: Shows memory galleries, song embed, mini music player, and visual parallax effects.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the hero section, love story content, and interactive puzzle and Q&A sections.
frontend/src/pages/StoryPage.tsx: Presents a timeline of key relationship moments plus flipbook, travel, and monthly memory sections.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color tokens, typography, animations, and extended theme options.
project_state.json: Holds project metadata, design/tech requirements, and a list of existing features for the Webloom Valentines site. Defines visual/UX goals, architecture notes, and versioned feature entries for planning.
